data.name: Darkest Desires Gift
data.description: You can use limited wish once per day as a spell-like ability. It can't duplicate a spell requiring a material component costing more than 1,000 gp. Each time you get more or less what you wished for (GM's discretion), you must succeed at a Will save (DC %1) or your corruption progresses to the next stage.|15+HellboundManifestationLevel
